Track 4 follow-up to `robofab-motorcurve`: repeats its nine motor-line rows with the time-optimal solver at 400, 1600 and 6400 nodes. The edge moves by at most 0.28 points from 1600 to 6400 (the 0.08 m, k=2, w0=4 row rises 4.98 to 5.26%), and the missing `cover` profile was a node-count limit. Stylised. 28 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
